background: Santander UK is the British ring-fenced bank of Banco Santander, funded by UK retail and business deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages and to UK companies, and the owner of TSB.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A from S&P and A1 from Moody's, all stable. The ratios are strong against UK majors: CET1 of 14.2% is in the top quarter against the peer median, leverage of 4.9% is at the median, and LCR of 166% and NSFR of 137% are in the top quarter and above the median respectively. CET1 has fallen 0.7 points since 30 Jun 2025 and the rest has been flat. The flagged news on 3 Aug 2026 and 10 Sep 2026 is the integration of TSB and the job cuts that go with it, a cost matter rather than a credit one. One of the better-placed UK majors on the figures.
